prior_knowledge: Published posteriors, original free-clock ceiling tM, and auditor approximate lnB at 5/8/10 tM already known. No blind status is claimed.
technical_status_rule: These are diagnostics/statuses, not physical verdicts or confirmation.

ESS.creation: After original C4 registration; now explicitly documented NONBLIND
ESS.meaning: Minimum local effective kernel samples for both restricted and GR point; no universal error guarantee

independent_density.scope: Independent density approximation, same released samples and physical curves; not statistically independent evidence
checks: Actual Uniform deformation priors and support
Finite samples and positive definite covariance
Direct formula versus scipy multivariate_normal at zero

free_clock.coordinate: q=tau_source/tM_source conditional on each nuisance sample
free_clock.new_prior_INPUT: Uniform source tau in [tP,20*tM_source], conditional mass-normalization retained
free_clock.curve_cut: First crossing of lnB=-log(100) on q in [0,40], if bracketed. Relative density diagnostic, not a prior-free credible bound or calibrated exclusion.
free_clock.posterior: q quantiles conditional on each stated finite ceiling; original seconds bounds retained from original result
free_clock.convergence: Compare q95 and log-integral on .05 versus .10 grids; target relative q95 change<0.005 and absolute log-integral change<0.001, otherwise unresolved
limitations: No universal shared clock catalog inference
No claim of genuinely prior-free posterior upper bound
No inference outside measured q range
